lines.trans: I am a little worried.
Worried about what?
Yin Zhengyu is too sought-after right now, and he has tons of work offers.
So I thought up a backup plan; I do not know whether it is workable.
Go on.
Yin Zhengyu's own younger brother Yin Jiaxi — his older brother dotes on him.
Yin Jiaxi debuted two years ago, and right now he is really popular.
Got it — not bad.
The boss approved it — I will go carry it out right away!
